cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before our qualifier, do the debrief I used to make you do. What's the result neither of us wants to say?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want you carrying that onto the ice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I already am. You used to hide behind that answer too. Say the result first; I'll follow you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We might not qualify. I'd still want to skate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, but don't skate past the second bit. What were you reassuring me about? Say what you think I'm afraid you'd do.

reason: Use specific familiar feedback and old pupil habits to shape the exact pursuit, without attributing every obstacle to a deliberate test. B actual contribution must change the next request.
